turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: How have your energy levels been throughout the mornings this week?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A bit groggy at first, but once I get that first cup of black coffee down, I start easing into the routine.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: That makes sense. Have you been able to maintain a regular bedtime schedule?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Mostly around eleven. Some nights I read a chapter of my book, other nights I just turn the lights out right away.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: What kind of book are you reading currently?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My wife looks so tired lately. I know it's because of me. She's working double shifts just to pay for my treatments.
